text.p: Tropical Storm Hannah will mainly threaten shipping as it moves westward in the southwest Pacific. It has winds of 50-55 mph during the next 24 hours, 40-45 mph thereafter. It will move in the general direction of south Philippines during this period.

Tropical cyclone Pancho is mainly a risk to shipping in the eastern part of the south Indian Ocean. Top winds now at 45 mph may increase to 85 mph during the next 24-48 hours. It is currently centered near 9.5s and 96.0e.

Tropical cyclone Gretelle will become an increasing risk to shipping north of Mauritius during the next 12-24 hours as winds increase to near 50 mph. It then turns southward and continues to strengthen thereafter. This system may threaten either the east coast of Madagascar or the island of Reunion later in this period.
